scope: Named technique families and inspected source anchors. Caller-by-caller coverage and full strongest-SWI acceptance remain open.

measurement_routes.ordinary: CETTA_OPEN_EQUATIONS_REFERENCE=1 and CETTA_PREPARED_PURE_REFERENCE=1; ordinary selection and binding services remain enabled
measurement_routes.independent_reference: feature-specific reference controls; preserve complete observations, not only printed scalar results

families.admission: Keep exact and wildcard occurrences in source order; retain the logical-update snapshot.
families.remaining_transfer: Measure overlays and candidate-catalog reconciliation separately.
families.validity: The entered cursor leases its occurrence snapshot. New entries consult current space/program identities; a later mutation must not rewrite an already-entered logical-update snapshot.

families.admission: Discard only refuted candidates under current source, binding and callability observations. Plain PeTTa does not require a table declaration.
families.remaining_transfer: Audit list-carrier bypasses, all-open discriminators, transaction/profile restrictions, and repeated verification. Separate selection permission from table-generation permission.
families.validity: A conservative decision uses the current binding view and source/classifier authority. It cannot carry a bound discriminator through rollback or mutation without revalidation.

families.admission: Pattern plans must preserve nonlinear variables, scope, occurs checks and authoritative fallback.
families.remaining_transfer: Identify ordinary candidate entry points still reinterpreting an available pattern plan.
families.validity: The equation and its compiled pattern share a retained source identity. Variable scope, nonlinear correlation and current bindings remain matcher inputs.

families.admission: Authored syntax plus a registered live frame denotes the value; return policy and delayed constraints remain authoritative.
families.remaining_transfer: Replace global list-history refusal with operand-specific evidence or the shared contextual unifier; qualify both before adoption.
families.validity: The syntax owner, frame incarnation and branch store must stay live. An epoch alone does not authorize borrowing after frame retirement.

families.admission: One authoritative assignment per frame slot; writes and schema changes obey rollback and ownership.
families.remaining_transfer: Reduce remaining fallback conversions and repeated slot/schema lookup without creating another binding authority.
families.validity: Direct slots are valid for their registered frame directory and current branch. Exclusive ownership and trail restoration are separate obligations.

families.admission: Borrowed scopes remain valid only during the stable read; children inherit their resolved parent context.
families.remaining_transfer: Transfer root/field demand to ordinary consumers that currently materialize entire terms.
families.validity: No write, rollback, collection, frame-directory replacement or owner release may intervene in the borrowed read. Reads do not grant execution authority.

families.admission: Readiness, type authority, computation/data provenance and result demand are separate judgments.
families.remaining_transfer: Consolidate their transport through ordinary, prepared and host entry without adding per-scalar descriptor allocation.
families.validity: Readiness, source interpretation, type evidence and result demand have distinct scopes. Changed declarations and mutable classifier dependencies reopen guards.

families.admission: Value, failure, raised error, interruption and suspension remain distinct; acceptance and publication retain their owner.
families.remaining_transfer: Extend existing adapters instead of introducing a second universal outcome type.
families.validity: The producer owns payload and environment through pending delivery. Accepted occurrences are not replayed; cancellation releases pending ownership.

families.admission: The adapter owns roots and demand; stack links grant no evaluation or lifetime authority.
families.remaining_transfer: Share operational services while preserving PeTTa search order and HE completion boundaries.
families.validity: Links borrow stable frame addresses until popped. The dialect adapter retains roots, entered code, demand and scoped control.

families.admission: Reuse must preserve the term/context identity and keep every reachable owner valid; opaque values require their own ownership descriptor.
families.remaining_transfer: Remove unnecessary copies at certified boundaries and measure retention of source capsules.
families.validity: Sharing requires a live immutable owner with matching generation. An escaped value must own or retain its reachable graph; reachability does not bound whole-owner retention.

families.admission: Logical list tags, rest tails, multiplicity and element identity must remain visible.
families.remaining_transfer: Audit consumers that flatten or rebuild before an outer-shape observation.
families.validity: A view keeps its underlying buffer alive. Normalized open-list shape can change with bindings and cannot be inferred from a raw header alone.

families.admission: Immutable direct support is stable; its images depend on the current logical store and lexical frame.
families.remaining_transfer: Reuse support observations at remaining activation/selection boundaries; do not cache live verdicts across writes or rollback.
families.validity: Syntactic support belongs to immutable structure. Contextual groundness follows live bindings and rollback; branch-local results cannot become syntax-only facts.

families.admission: Only proved groundness or fresh-frame noninterference can omit a cycle search.
families.remaining_transfer: Map each ordinary binding entry to its strongest available evidence; keep uncertain cases on the exact check.
families.validity: A fresh cell certificate must name the incarnation and disjoint support that justify omitting a cycle walk. Unknown or overflowing support uses the authoritative walker.

families.admission: Every future rollback observes the same assignments, aliases, constraints and services.
families.remaining_transfer: Share the write/rollback contract; evaluate direct slots and conditional logging where lifetime frontiers permit it.
families.validity: Only writes that cannot survive the current rollback boundary may omit a trail entry. PeTTa choice marks do not establish HE snapshot policy.

families.admission: Retain transitive support, constraints and rollback-visible roots; preserve entry order and frame ownership.
families.remaining_transfer: Avoid repeated support extraction and unnecessary frame reconstruction only where measured profitable.
families.validity: Projection uses the current root group, shared variable map and environment. Independently freshening correlated components is invalid.

families.admission: Collection admission and rollback roots remain unchanged; failed collection scheduling uses saturating growth thresholds.
families.remaining_transfer: Price declined scans, successful collection, retained memory and delayed collection after choice-shape changes.
families.validity: Retry thresholds schedule an attempt and grant no collection authority. Collection admission and live-root preservation remain unchanged.

families.admission: A plan is reusable only while every source and authority dependency it consulted is current.
families.remaining_transfer: Unify exact dependency validation; test pooled stamps only with collision and overflow accounting. Unknown foreign writes retain a global dependency.
families.validity: A plan records its source, declarations, space and foreign authority reads. Absence is a dependency; unknown writes remain globally conservative.

families.admission: Only dependency-qualified stable refusal may be cached; transient resource failure is not semantic refusal.
families.remaining_transfer: Share positive/negative dependency discipline and measure repeated failed admission across routes.
families.validity: Only a stable semantic refusal is reusable under its complete dependency footprint. Interrupt, allocation failure and transient capacity are not permanent refusals.

families.admission: Exact builtin and wrapper provenance plus no carried effects justify the specific read-only failure rule.
families.remaining_transfer: Extend effect summaries only with truthful predicate dependencies and mutation/override controls.
families.validity: Read-only classification must be proved for the actual foreign target and current provider authority. Unknown writes invalidate conservatively.

families.admission: Preserve integer promotion, float order, operand demand, type checks and dialect Boolean representation.
families.remaining_transfer: Reuse primitive implementations in ordinary and prepared consumers; inspect redundant boxing and type observations.
families.validity: The selected intrinsic must be unoverridden in the current source. Exact arithmetic, floating order and dialect truth values remain part of the result contract.

families.admission: A segment has the admitted effect, type and fuel contract; refusal preserves original evaluation.
families.remaining_transfer: Share operation and liveness machinery, retaining different entry/result policies.
families.validity: Admission includes source/effect authority, value shapes and complete result behavior. Ready operands alone do not establish purity or checked results.

families.admission: The source recurrence, recursive call protocol and observer must authorize the fold.
families.remaining_transfer: Share scans, value operations and ownership plumbing with ordinary execution; preserve non-admitted source behavior.
families.validity: The authored fold, matching/unification behavior, arithmetic and current definitions must support the lowering. Failed admission retains ordinary execution.

families.admission: The admitted closure/count observer determines duplicate handling, ordering, effects and resumption; navigation quantum is not dialect fuel.
families.remaining_transfer: Reuse worklists, indexes and cursor lifecycle; do not replace arbitrary budgeted search with closure.
families.validity: The observer must permit the region algebra. Set closure does not justify dropping ordered occurrences, effects, bounded prefixes or proof provenance.

families.admission: Correct output is necessary but does not establish an application gain.
families.remaining_transfer: Support-union memo, flat matcher variants and append-right-unit candidate remain outside production until stronger cost and lifetime evidence.
families.validity: These candidates supply no production authority. Their observations and costs remain retained evidence until a revised candidate passes its own gates.

families.admission: Bounded physical-structure observations under PeTTa term equality; unknown metadata and rational unfoldings decline. Every survivor retains exact comparison.
families.remaining_transfer: The record scan remains linear. Other consumers require their own equality/observation policy before reusing this prefilter.
families.validity: Only immutable structural fields enter the stored fingerprint. Actual observations are local to one synchronous lookup; PeTTa structural equality is required. Every survivor still receives exact equality.

families.admission: A complete head-membership index can only reject an absent specialized head. Space identity, alpha equality, payload permission and occurrence order remain authoritative.
families.validity: Record creation extends a complete index incrementally; removal and thread reset invalidate it. Incomplete allocation uses the original traversal. Small catalogs remain linear.
families.remaining_transfer: Selective lookup within a present head remains linear. Other code/site caches need their own dependency footprints.

coverage: All 26 named families have a disposition, native source anchors, file-level occurrence census, admission, validity and measurement obligations. Caller-by-caller transfer completion and the full ordinary-route workload baseline remain open.

review_reconciliation.idea: Shared call contract over existing engines
review_reconciliation.next: Join demand, scoped evidence and argument transport through existing interfaces; retain direct lowering for ordinary scalar calls.

review_reconciliation.idea: Arity preflight and live argument guard
review_reconciliation.next: Measure remaining contextual resolution after an admitted pure entry and underapplication; do not reapply the older patch.

review_reconciliation.idea: Borrow captured and supplied argument spans
review_reconciliation.next: Validate borrowed-span owner lifetime and collection memo identity, including slices of unequal lengths. oem_collect_slots mutates activation locals only; young argument vectors are copied and old argument vectors remain unchanged. Avoid allocating a replacement array of wrapper records.
Share successful reads with prepared consumers and preserve live aliases, rollback and normalization-sensitive list fallback.
Measure support cardinality weighted by avoided traversal; compare construction, relocation and retention costs before adding a two- or four-cell summary.
Measure reachable bytes separately from retained-owner bytes. Preserve one relocation map per correlated export group.

review_reconciliation.idea: Separate code, dispatch and observation caches
review_reconciliation.next: Unify dependency validation without merging source validity with live-cell validity; keep transient failure distinct from stable refusal.

review_reconciliation.idea: Ordered log plus membership index plus delta
review_reconciliation.next: Preserve occurrence order, duplicate derivations, authored round counters and budgeted prefixes. Compiler-owned emission changes need their own admission.
Prove alias, early-constraint and source-version obligations before discarding data or moving equality checks.
Prove and test complete continuation, entered-code, constraint, older-alternative and budget state. Post-effect fallback must not restart the source call.
Connect actual scoped reads, opening, exports and compiler read footprints to the existing Lean models. Bounds exclude unmodelled native allocation and wall time.
Use CBPV as the shared semantic contract. Adopt runtime abstractions only when adapters disappear and ordinary-call cost is preserved or improved.

non_prolog_comparisons.application: Profile-guided indexed access and bounded experiments; CeTTa retains its ordered operational observer.
Keep effects and speculation permission separate; these interfaces do not establish CeTTa control semantics.
Ownership and reuse under explicit control flow; no automatic transfer to cyclic logical graphs.
